facts.fact: FASUCE committee chair Luc Missidimbazi said that in five years the fund deployed 254 sites in 244 localities, connecting more than 500,000 people, and the minister said the government will continue the policy.
facts.system: Fonds pour l'accès et le service universel des communications électroniques (Fasuce)

facts.fact: FASUCE inaugurated connections for the rural localities of Miaba and Ehota on 27 January 2026 and says it will continue until the last village is connected.
